verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's official H200 page publishes capacity (141GB), memory type (HBM3e), and bandwidth (4.8TB/s), and a runtime probe confirms this spec table is live and fetchable; independent commentary also confirms it's HBM3e stacks on the H100 die. However, memory bus width is never stated anywhere in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: explicit memory bus-width figure, and any independent/third-party spec-sheet corroboration beyond NVIDIA's own page.
